headline: Faridpur: Young man dies in DB custody after being picked up
summary: Family members allege the youth was healthy before being taken by Detective Branch police, only to die later that night.
details: A young man has died while in the custody of the Detective Branch (DB) of the police in Faridpur.
According to family members, the youth was in good health when he was picked up by DB officers in the afternoon.
However, the family alleges that he passed away during the night while remaining in police custody.
The incident has sparked concerns over the treatment of detainees in police custody in the region.
caption:
Picked up in the afternoon, dead by night. A family's grief turns to anger as a youth dies in DB custody.

A young man has died while in the custody of the Detective Branch (DB) of the police in Faridpur.

According to family members, the youth was in good health when he was picked up by DB officers in the afternoon.

However, the family alleges that he passed away during the night while remaining in police custody.

The incident has sparked concerns over the treatment of detainees in police custody in the region.

#Faridpur #PoliceCustody #HumanRights #Bangladesh #Justice

Source: Somoy News, Jamuna TV

headline_marked: Video shows [[youth firing gun near garment factory]] in Chattogram
headline: Video shows youth firing gun near garment factory in Chattogram
summary: A CCTV clip captures a man in a pink t-shirt firing a pistol in the Kalurghat Industrial Area, sparking police investigations into local dominance and extortion.
details: A viral CCTV video shows a youth in a pink t-shirt pulling a pistol from his back pocket and firing shots toward a garment factory in Chattogram's Kalurghat Heavy Industrial Area.
The 37-second footage reveals the man standing on the road, firing blank shots at the factory before continuing to walk while holding the weapon aloft.
Police and local sources report that a group of five people, including the gunman, were present in front of the UNESCO garment factory on Saturday morning.
Local residents claim the incident is linked to ongoing disputes over dominance, extortion, and control of factories within the BSCIC industrial area.
Following the shooting, a local Jubdal leader was reportedly threatened, although he did not respond to phone calls for comment.
Chandgaon Police Station OC Jasim Uddin confirmed that the police are investigating the matter, though no formal written complaint has been filed yet.
caption:
A man in a pink t-shirt was caught on CCTV firing a pistol in broad daylight in Chattogram.

A viral CCTV video shows a youth in a pink t-shirt pulling a pistol from his back pocket and firing shots toward a garment factory in Chattogram's Kalurghat Heavy Industrial Area.

The 37-second footage reveals the man standing on the road, firing blank shots at the factory before continuing to walk while holding the weapon aloft.

Police and local sources report that a group of five people, including the gunman, were present in front of the UNESCO garment factory on Saturday morning.

Local residents claim the incident is linked to ongoing disputes over dominance, extortion, and control of factories within the BSCIC industrial area.

Following the shooting, a local Jubdal leader was reportedly threatened, although he did not respond to phone calls for comment.

Chandgaon Police Station OC Jasim Uddin confirmed that the police are investigating the matter, though no formal written complaint has been filed yet.

#Chattogram #CrimeNews #Bangladesh #LawAndOrder #Kalurghat

Source: Prothom Alo, Somoy News, Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV
